title: An authorizer callback remains registered after its heap context is freed and dereferences that context during statement preparation.
live_note: The defect is in the binding, not in SQLite: this corpus pins no binding release, and the host arm builds the 3.53.3 amalgamation, so whether a row is live in a given binding version is not established here.

host-asan.observed: cited issue is a read-only-protection test failure — no use-after-free PoC

virtual-malloc.oracle: virtual profile, SQLite 3.53.3 on virtual mallocng (tools/arms.json virtual-mallocng; shared/run-virtual.py): a heap-use-after-free or bad-free row is CAUGHT by a fault in its declared fault_sites after main began, MISSED when it completes; a null-deref row is its own class and a none row is correct at exit 0, neither scored as a temporal catch (the project lead's decision, 2026-10-22)
virtual-malloc.verdict_note: cause=25 pc=0x3f9c411e58 in authorize; by function: authorize is the row's declared site (host ASan's frame #0)
